note: Private RV park on the south-east edge of Medicine Hat, beside Ross Creek and a 10-20 km drive from the city's attractions. A rail line runs right along the east side of the park (train noise). The shower and washroom building is seasonal, April to October as the weather allows. --Claude
summary: Operator pages: C$52 (30A) / C$56 (50A) daily plus GST, weekly and monthly too; open year round; 41 full-hookup 50/30-amp sites with pull-throughs; reservations by phone/contact form; showers seasonal; phone 403-526-5809 -> 403-581-7975 recommended.
